reason: The README clearly describes a plugin that reduces model context usage by curating long successful tool outputs and optionally spilling complete results to local files for later retrieval.

summaries.zh: 在工具结果进入模型上下文前筛选长文本，保留关键行并可将完整输出写入本地文件供后续查看。
summaries.en: Curates long text results from tools before they enter the model context, preserving key lines and optionally saving the complete output locally for later inspection.

capabilities: curates long tool output by retaining head, tail, and matching lines
writes complete output to local spill files when enabled
replaces model-facing tool content with the curated result
